purpose: Define the minimum request, KV event, and eviction-decision records needed to validate a future Agent-specific policy.

identity_rules.stable_prefix_digest: Hash the complete cache namespace and page-aligned token prefix. Do not use transient node_id as the cross-event identity.
identity_rules.cache_namespace_hash: Must include every namespace component used by the runtime matcher.
identity_rules.shared_prefix_accounting: Count a shared physical prefix once and record referencing sessions separately.

derived_diagnostics.h_policy: Actual page-aligned matched tokens reported by the runtime for the request.
derived_diagnostics.h_history: Maximum page-aligned prefix provably present earlier under the same namespace and insertion semantics; initially a historical reference, not a strict physical infinite-cache bound.
derived_diagnostics.extra_recompute: max(0, h_history - h_policy); label as eviction-caused only when event coverage proves prior store, later eviction, and subsequent demand.
derived_diagnostics.competition_tokens: Distinct newly stored logical tokens between two demands of the same stable prefix.
derived_diagnostics.counterfactual_net_loss: Future loss of selected victims minus future loss of an alternative legal set that releases at least the same token/byte budget.
